name: Lake Austin Spa Resort
insider_take: This lakeside sanctuary sits on 19 acres along the shores of Lake Austin, offering a serene escape just minutes from downtown's vibrant energy.
whats_special: Lake Austin Spa Resort is one of the few luxury spa resorts in the U.S. where you can kayak directly from your hotel to explore pristine waters. The resort's LakeHouse Spa features treatments using local Texas botanicals, and their farm-to-table restaurant sources ingredients from their own organic garden and local Austin purveyors.
pro_tip: Book a sunrise paddleboard session - Lake Austin's calm morning waters offer perfect conditions and stunning views of the Hill Country, plus you'll often spot local wildlife including great blue herons and turtles.
dont_miss: The resort's signature Hill Country Stone treatment at the spa, and dining at Arlo Grey - helmed by James Beard Award-winning chef Kristen Kish. Take advantage of the complimentary sunset boat cruise to see Austin's famous bat colony emerging from the Congress Avenue Bridge.
pros: Stunning lakefront location on Lake Austin with private waterfront access
World-class spa featuring holistic wellness programs and luxurious treatments
Farm-to-table dining with fresh, locally-sourced cuisine
Comprehensive fitness and outdoor activities including kayaking, hiking, and yoga
cons: Adults-only property focused on wellness and relaxation
Secluded location requiring transportation to downtown Austin attractions
